scope: Finite future analyst recipes only; no WAV/MIDI/ALS/render/hardware baseline retained
F0: F0 plus case-specific F-AUDIO/F-MIDI/F-PATH/F-EXTERNAL/F-CUE/F-LATENCY prerequisites; use copies of a valid editable Set, reset unrelated routes, clips, solo/mute, automation, preferences and held notes between trials. Actual supported interfaces and accepted displayed settings must be independently retained; missing capabilities leave the probe U. No physical hardware, driver or application execution is performed by this packet.
F-AUDIO: Before execution retain owned dual-mono WAV A: 440 Hz sine peak 0.0625 for seconds [0,1), silence [1,2), repeat for 8 s; separate WAV B uses 997 Hz in [1,2), silence [0,1), repeat. For channel tests put A on left/B on right in a separately retained stereo file. Pin actual rate/channels/frames/bytes/hash; silence intervals alone cannot prove a route.
F-MIDI: Retain owned event sequence and exact transport codec: notes 48/60 at different known beats, distinct channels and admitted velocities, each with matched Note Off; separate CC event not consumed by an existing map. Identify each receiving instrument/channel independently; nothing is sent to physical gear here.
F-PATH: Use A/B sender tracks, C receiver, actual return R, a separate instrument host M and MIDI sender N. Establish each source and each return/output contribution independently at nonzero gain with correct monitor/arm/active-clip context. A distinct effect or plug-in path requires independently known positive behavior; names/fields/unsupported assumed plug-ins do not qualify.
F-EXTERNAL: Requires actually available enabled interface/ports, independently identified donor/receiver and calibrated known nonzero source+return. Preserve channel/device identity, driver, routing and uncertainty. Availability is unproven; do not substitute a fake host or arbitrary loopback for hardware.
F-CUE: Requires two independently known dedicated stereo output pairs, distinct Main/Cue identity, known hardware mixer/return paths and nonzero source on each in positive controls. Browser preview input is separately retained owned B. No hardware resource is claimed present.
F-LATENCY: Requires a qualifying built-in/device/plugin path with independently established nonzero returned signal and reported/measured latency context, plus separately characterized direct and return paths. Retain accepted controls/reporting/driver/rate/block settings and measurement uncertainty before future timing claims; no latency calculation is supplied.
positive-path-gate: Confirm correct source and destination/tap, compatible signal type, active instrument/effect/device/output, nonzero gain/send/return/wet contribution, actual monitor/arm/clip state, and independent positive source+return baseline. Isolate competing direct, dry, main, return, cue, mapped-MIDI and hardware-mixer paths. A no-effect or exclusion case needs its matching active positive control. Failed, absent or uncalibrated prerequisites remain inconclusive/U.
comparison: All expected/comparison fields for the target are null and all probes unexecuted; documentary predicates compare visible control/state only. Every signal/timing/lifecycle unknown has null documentary oracle. No runtime, calibration, performance or compatibility proof.
F-MONITOR-INDICATOR: Future owned disposable audio/MIDI tracks separately, valid actual Monitor In and I/O visibility controls, independently recorded actual monitor/Activator/theme/selection/focus state. First establish a genuinely visible blue In Activator indicator positive baseline with I/O shown; only then hide the same I/O and inspect the same indicator, restore I/O and independently verify In. This categorical display observation is not RGB/theme coverage or audio activation. Missing/invisible/unsupported control or failed visible baseline stays U, never a passing absence test. Where any signal exclusion is separately proposed, retain original productive nonzero path gates; display alone never proves audio.
